{{recipe}} 

These ribs have beaten some of the best BBQ joints around, including Famous Dave's and Roscoe's, in local competitions.

== Ingredients ==

* 2 slabs baby-back [[Cookbook:Pork|pork]] ribs
* [[Cookbook:Rib Rub|Rib Rub]]
* [[Cookbook:Maple Barbecue Sauce|Maple Barbecue Sauce]]
* Hickory and applewood chunks

== Procedure ==
#Remove membrane on the bottom of the ribs. Season both sides liberally with rib rub and refrigerate at least 1 hour.
#Place enough hickory and applewood chunks in the firebox of a [[Cookbook:Smoker|smoker]] to keep the temperature around 200 °F (95 °C).
#Place ribs in smoker and cook, brushing with barbecue sauce every 1½ hours for 4 hours or until very tender, changing chunks as needed.
#[[Cookbook:Brush|Brush]] meat side of ribs liberally with sauce and place meat side down on a very, very hot [[Cookbook:Grill|grill]] until well browned and slightly charred.
#Slice into one-rib portions and serve with additional sauce.
